en: A vintage black‑and‑white street scene in a European spa town. Grand multi‑story historic buildings line both sides of a broad street with shopfronts at ground level, including arched windows and signs. Trees form an avenue in the middle distance, beyond which bath and spa buildings rise against a wooded hillside. People in early 20th‑century fashion stroll along the sidewalks and street. Red printed caption text at the top right reads "Karlsbad Eingang zur Alten Wiese."
